content: Mifepristone can increase the levels or effects of haloperidol by interfering with hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Close monitoring is advised if coadministration is necessary. Mifepristone is contraindicated with heparin due to the risk of excessive post-abortion bleeding in patients on anticoagulant therapy. Histrelin increases the toxicity of mifepristone by prolonging the QTc interval. This combination should be avoided or replaced with an alternative therapy. There is an increased risk of torsades de pointes, and close monitoring is required. Mifepristone can increase the levels or effects of hydrocodone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Mifepristone is contraindicated with hydrocortisone. The mechanism of interaction is unknown, but mifepristone is contraindicated in patients on long-term corticosteroid therapy. Hydroxychloroquine sulfate and mifepristone both prolong the QTc interval. This combination should be avoided or replaced with an alternative therapy. Mifepristone can increase the levels or effects of hydroxyprogesterone caproate (DSC) by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug.
